title: The Pokémon shop break-in
summary: Thousands of Pokémon cards vanished from Terri’s Trinkets and Toys. Start with the reported break-in, then follow the public record.

detail.note: Police confirmed a break-in report in the September 11 coverage. No later outcome was found in the sources reviewed; current police investigation status is unconfirmed.

claims.text: The owner estimated about 7,000 cards and roughly $6,000 in merchandise were taken.
The Free Press reported police confirmation of a commercial break-in involving more than $5,000 in stolen property.

timeline.text: Break-in reported at the collectibles shop.
The Free Press published the owner’s account and police confirmation.
Keep Canada Weird covered the Winnipeg Pokémon break-in.

title: The $70,000 card theft
summary: After a trading night at Mulvey Market, a seller reported a major Pokémon card theft. What can the public reporting establish?

detail.note: The owner said a police report was filed. CityNews had not received a police response at publication. Current police investigation status is unconfirmed. No connection to the other Winnipeg theft has been established here.

claims.text: The seller estimated the missing cards and products at about $70,000.
The owner believed someone remained inside after closing. This is an account to verify, not a police finding.

timeline.text: The reported theft followed a Friday trading event.
Keep Canada Weird discussed the Mulvey Market theft.

title: A night out. A witness appeal.
summary: Vancouver Police asked witnesses to come forward after reported threats and property damage at a downtown fast-food restaurant.

detail.note: VPD described an ongoing investigation on September 3. No later outcome was found in the reviewed sources. The appeal is dated; it does not establish the investigation’s status today.

claims.text: VPD said two men allegedly threatened staff and customers, claimed to have guns, and damaged property.
Police were reviewing CCTV and asked anyone with information to contact investigators.

timeline.text: VPD published a witness appeal and said its investigation was ongoing.
Keep Canada Weird discussed the restaurant incident.
